newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia sees mobile phone licence tender in Oct.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia sees mobile phone licence tender in Oct.

text.p: The Slovenian government will announce a tender for a mobile phone licence by mid-November, Minister of Traffic Anton Bergauer said on Thursday.
"The tender will most probably be announced in October," Bergauer told a news conference.
"I expect the licences will be granted by the end of the year and it is my estimation that two to three licences will be offered although the number has not been determined yet."
He said the ministry had already received nine applications for a mobile phone licence.
So far only state-owned Mobitel has permission to operate a mobile telephone network but earlier this month the constitutional court ruled the monopoly was unconstitutional.
